WITH trader_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
with_share_and_avg AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    cnt,
    cnt::FLOAT / SUM(cnt::FLOAT) OVER () as shr,
    AVG(cnt::FLOAT) OVER () as avg_cnt
  FROM trader_counts
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    cnt,
    shr,
    (cnt::FLOAT - avg_cnt) as excess
  FROM with_share_and_avg
  WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
)
SELECT
  SUM(cnt) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(shr) as avg_of_shares,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM filtered;

assumptions.assumption: The average count is calculated across only trader types represented in the filtered data (those with at least one advanced behaviour record linked to valid transaction and trader), not including trader types with zero linked records.
